arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/docs.test.ts'; s=open(p).read()
old='''/** The text outside fenced code blocks and inline code, where links are links. */
const prose = (markdown: string): string =>
	markdown.replaceAll(FENCE_PATTERN, "").replaceAll(INLINE_CODE_PATTERN, "");
'''
new='''/** The text outside fenced code blocks, where headings are headings. */
const outsideFences = (markdown: string): string =>
	markdown.replaceAll(FENCE_PATTERN, "");

/** The text outside fenced code blocks and inline code, where links are links. */
const prose = (markdown: string): string =>
	outsideFences(markdown).replaceAll(INLINE_CODE_PATTERN, "");
'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace("for (const [, heading = \"\"] of prose(markdown).matchAll(HEADING_PATTERN))","for (const [, heading = \"\"] of outsideFences(markdown).matchAll(\n\t\tHEADING_PATTERN,\n\t))")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npx vitest run src/docs.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "×|Tests"
